answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 30% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the plume ordering is published with the jetty batch, the voyage audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early as a result gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Honest users pay that once, farms 29 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
